proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.area_dispersed_by_wind
proposed_widenings.justification: The fog ends early when dispersed by strong wind (such as Gust of Wind). This is a spell-interaction environmental trigger absent from the current DurationEndTrigger enum. Neither target_makes_attack_roll, target_deals_damage, target_casts_spell, target_dons_armor, target_damaged_by_caster_or_ally, target_takes_damage, nor caster_recasts_spell covers a named-spell environmental dispersion.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The fog lasts for the duration or until strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it, ending the spell.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.once_per_turn_dedup predicate
proposed_widenings.justification: RAW states 'A creature makes this save only once per turn,' but the surface has no dedup predicate on OngoingOperation triggers. Encoding both on_creature_enters_area and on_creature_ends_turn_in_area without this predicate would misrepresent RAW by allowing up to two saves in one turn. This is the same known gap as Spirit Guardians and Web.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature makes this save only once per turn.

proposed_widenings.name: area_is_heavily_obscured
proposed_widenings.justification: The sphere is Heavily Obscured for its entire duration. The existing area_is_difficult_terrain atom covers movement geometry but not visibility. Heavily Obscured is a distinct Rules-Glossary concept with its own mechanical consequences (Disadvantage on Perception checks, attacks targeting creatures inside). Caller-owned per ARCHITECTURE.md §1 (same as Moonbeam's Dim Light), so omitted from the encoding.

proposed_widenings.name: automatic area drift (on_caster_turn_start → reposition_attachment without action cost)
proposed_widenings.justification: The sphere drifts 10 feet away from the caster automatically at the start of each caster turn, requiring no action. The existing reposition_attachment atom is defined as a 'mid-duration caster action.' A variant with no action cost and a fixed directional drift (away from caster) is needed. Per existing precedent (Moonbeam, Spirit Guardians), this is treated as caller-owned geometry and omitted.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The Sphere moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.

notes: Core mechanic (area sphere, Con save, 5d8 Poison, half on success, slot-scaled damage) fits cleanly. Encoded via ongoing_effect family with initialPhase (creatures in sphere at cast) + on_attached_turn_start operation. Four omissions follow established precedent: cloud drift and Heavily Obscured are caller-owned per ARCHITECTURE.md §1 (same pattern as Moonbeam); once-per-turn dedup is the same surface gap as Spirit Guardians and Web; strong wind dispersal needs a new DurationEndTrigger variant. The on_creature_enters_area trigger (creatures entering after cast) is not separately encoded to avoid misrepresenting the once-per-turn dedup rule.
